identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I Clinical Trial of Human CD19/BCMA Bispecific CAR-T Cell Therapy for Subjects With Relapsed and Refractory POMES Syndrome.

descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Primary Objectives

1. To determine the feasibility ad safety of anti-CD19/BCMA CAR-T cells in treating patients with relapsed and refractory POMES Syndrome.

Secondary Objectives

1. To access the efficacy of anti-CD19/BCMA CAR-T cells in patients with POMES Syndrome.
2. To determine in vivo dynamics and persistency of anti-CD19/BCMA CAR-T cells.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety measured by occurrence of study related adverse effects defined by NCI CTCAE 4.0
primaryOutcomes.description: Safety measured by occurrence of study related adverse effects defined by NCI CTCAE 4.0

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Overall complete remission rate defined by the standard response criteria for POMES Syndrome
secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall complete remission rate defined by the standard response criteria for POMES Syndrome

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration of CAR-positive T cells in circulation
secondaryOutcomes.description: Duration of CAR-positive T cells in circulation
